title: Spectra Supportworks
text:
Spectra Supportworks

notes:
Lead source: inbound from product documentation + G2 mention. Founder/CTO: Anika Bhatt (ex-helpdesk startup). Primary ask: plug a hosted inference API into existing support pipeline (Zendesk + webhook layer).

Key problem: agents get overloaded with context; need automated summaries + structured payload so routing + tag rules run reliably. Also want tool-calling to open/update tickets and append canonical JSON to ticket body.

Requirements quoted from call: "We need a 1-2 sentence TL;DR + key metadata (issue_type, suggested route, confidence) for each ticket. JSON must be stable for 3rd-party parsers."

Latency/throughput: target median latency <=300ms for triage calls, peaks ~50-80 req/s during support spikes. Cost: high sensitivity - startup budget, looking to keep cost < $0.01 per triage call if possible.

Model preferences: start with a cost-effective open model for triage + cheap fallback; higher-quality model for summaries. Want routing/fallbacks by policy.

Security: SMB but they have EU SMB customers; require SSO (SAML), audit logs, and retention controls (able to auto-delete after 30/90 days). Not asking for full private deployment now - prefer Redwood hosted for speed.

POC ask: 2-week hosted API POC using 5k real tickets (sanitized) -> evaluate latency, cost, and structured output stability. Wants sample quickstart + cURL snippets and Node SDK example for tool-calling.

Notes/actions: send hosted_api quickstart, include example of streaming vs non-streaming for tool calls; attach pricing sheet with per-1k token breakdown. Confirm retention SLA and whether logs can be disabled for specific routes.

Quote from CTO on call: "We want to turn ticket chaos into predictable metadata—if Redwood can show predictable unit economics, we move fast."

timeline:
2026-02-18: inbound from product hunt / docs - created trial account (self-serve)
2026-02-20: intro call - Liam (AE) + CTO Anika Bhatt; demo of ticket summarizer prototype
2026-02-25: requested example of structured JSON output for Zendesk create_ticket flow
2026-03-02: sandbox test: 500 sample tickets - summarization quality pass, cost high
2026-03-04: SE sync with Maya - discussed batching, caching, model fallbacks

blockers:
confirm data retention policy
EU data residency for 2 enterprise customers
cost sensitivity - need per-ticket unit economics

next_step:
Schedule 30m POC with SE; send hosted API quickstart + pricing link

last_touch_summary:
AE handed to SE for POC design. SE to validate sample payload schema and run small perf test on hosted API. UX wants cURL + Node examples for webhooks.

additional_comments:
Happy to start self-serve; will convert to paid if POC shows 30-40% reduction in manual triage time.
